text: The formula for recall is given by the ratio of true positives (TP) to the sum of true positives and false negatives (FN), expressed as a fraction. The numerator contains only one term, TP, while the denominator includes two terms: TP and FN.
summary: Recall measures how many positive instances are correctly identified out of all actual positive instances in binary classification problems.

\frac { T P } { T P + F N }
